name: PalletLoadPlanner
tagline: Pallet patterns, layer limits and order pallet counts – right on the order record.
description: Advanced PCF control for manufacturers: generates interlocked case patterns for EUR, GMA and custom pallets, applies height, payload and crush limits, shows a 3D stack and calculates gross weight, load height and pallets per order. Saves validated plans with case coordinates as JSON.
features: Column, two-block and pinwheel layer patterns with interlocking even layers
Height, payload and crush-limit layer calculation with binding limit
Isometric 3D stack of full and last pallet with limit plane
Load summary: gross weight, load height, footprint and cube use, stability
Order quantity to pallets required and last partial pallet
Overhang, tie sheets, orientation rules, metric/imperial
Saved plans with reference and planJson output with case coordinates
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard, touch and ARIA
